## Personal & Open-Source Projects
- **a11ysis**: In-Page Live Accessibility Inspector and Continuous Scanner powered by a Triple-Engine Consensus architecture (IBM Equal Access 4.0, Deque Axe-core 4.10, and HTML_CodeSniffer 2.5). Eliminates automated audit fragmentation and tool discrepancies by running engines simultaneously in a collision-free Shadow DOM HUD mounted directly onto live web applications via script tag or bookmarklet. Provides on-hover element highlighting, real-time contrast ratio auditing, and instant remediation code snippets with zero data retention (100% client-side DOM evaluation). Fully aligned with WCAG 2.1 & 2.2 across Levels A, AA, and AAA, Section 508, and EN 301 549 (https://a11ysis.lets.gen.in/).
- **EdgeNonce**: Zero-latency CSP nonce streaming engine running on Cloudflare Workers and HTMLRewriter. Injects unique 128-bit dynamic nonces on the fly (under 1.5ms) without breaking origin CDN or AEM Dispatcher caching (100% cache retention). Enforces strict CSP Level 3 to satisfy PCI-DSS v4.0 (6.4.3 & 11.6.1), HIPAA, and GDPR (https://www.edge-nonce.com). Documentation: AEM Architecture Guide (https://www.edge-nonce.com/aem-services.html) and IHS Apache Configs (https://www.edge-nonce.com/apache-ihs-integration-guide.html).
- **StateGuard.js**: JavaScript utility locking DOM attributes against DevTools tampering for BFSI state integrity (https://rmsuthar.github.io/StateGuard/).
- **Global Edge Sandbox & LB Inspector**: Cloudflare Workers edge computing platform simulating 12 PoP locations globally with WebAuthn auth (https://gateway.lets.gen.in/).

Jointly analyzes First Name, Patronymic/Husband Name, and Clan Surname to compute probability distributions across 7 religious and cultural traditions. Powered by Python 3.12, Astral uv, and Cloudflare Workers (Pyodide Wasm) with a 5-tier caching pipeline delivering sub-0.5ms lookups across 330+ edge locations (https://castserv.lets.gen.in).

Details Conway's Law alignment, composition taxonomy (Build-time, Module Federation, Web Components, iFrames, Edge SSR), runtime shared scope governance, singletons & avoiding duplicate React runtimes, typed enterprise event buses, dual-router coordination, asynchronous circuit breakers, and zero-downtime dynamic discovery manifests (https://ravindra.lets.gen.in/mfe-architecture).
